## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. XLK RECOVERY (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) vs XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) and Tech vs Financials rising (level 2.7456, 1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.05%) confirm intra-equity rotation while VXX CORRECTION (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) shows mixed fear dynamics.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress easing: HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) and LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) ↑ rising and in RECOVERY. Stocks vs Bonds SPY/TLT (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.65%) ↑ rising RECOVERY adds cyclical tilt while VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) ↓ falling short term signals transitional risk sentiment.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-tight: TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY and HYG/LQD showing improvement; Dollar showing strength ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.38%) which keeps policy headwinds present.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech showing short-term strength: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) while Materials/Macro cyclicals are bid: Materials (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +2.01%) signals healthcare/biotech leadership; Style: growth/momentum leading but rotation active.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US equities stabilizing: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) while Europe showing relative strength: VGK (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI RECOVERY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.80%) but China Tech weakness persists.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation mixed: IWM RECOVERY (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -3.83%) and ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -8.50%) show selective risk-on flows while IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) signals crypto pullback.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Reflation bid concentrated in oil: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) while GLD RECOVERY (1W: +7.18% | 1M: -8.98%) shows safe-haven rebalancing.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy mixed: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) with strong 1M gains but short-term weakness; UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) confirming gas softness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +2.01%) and broad sector breadth (9/11) support rotation into cyclicals/materials; DIVERGENCE: VXX CORRECTION (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) and XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) are major 1W/1M mismatches indicating transitional flows.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclical exposure and materials: Materials (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) and Financials XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) showing strength; reduce exposure to IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) and monitor XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) for resolution of the 1W/1M split.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND; Materials (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) showing strength.  
BEARISH: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) and Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) and watch CPER (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -4.45%) for follow-through.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~35 (watch complacency vs stress), HYG/LQD ~0.73 (credit health pivot), SPY/TLT 7.56 (risk-on pivot), Tech vs Financials ~2.75 (leadership barometer).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, intra-equity rotation evident as XLK RECOVERY (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) and Materials (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) show relative strength. Key risk is the 1W/1M divergence in volatility and energy—VXX CORRECTION (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) and XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%)—monitor for trend resolution.
